description: Curated educational-map repairs for small U.S. river preview endpoint defects. These coordinates are not Natural Earth source geometry.

repairs.reason: Natural Earth's selected Colorado mainstem stops just north of the Gulf of California at app-map scale.
repairs.explanation: A short display-only extension carries the visible endpoint clearly into the Gulf of California / Sea of Cortez at app-map scale.

repairs.reason: Natural Earth parts 6 and 7 leave a visible 19 km gap in the Columbia mainstem.
repairs.explanation: A minimal display-only bridge closes the obvious mainstem discontinuity at app scale.

repairs.reason: Natural Earth's Columbia record stops before the Pacific mouth near the Washington/Oregon border.
repairs.explanation: A short display-scale estuary extension makes the river read as reaching the Pacific without changing source data.

repairs.reason: The selected Natural Earth Mississippi delta outlet branches visibly extend beyond the app's simplified Gulf coastline.
repairs.explanation: The preview omits only outer delta outlet parts and retains the Natural Earth mainstem to the coast; source geometry remains unchanged on disk.
